Not covered by that pass:

- Ollama and the model: staging runs one, but a cold model can take minutes to load, so /healthz's ollama check is reported and not gated on
- agent diagnosis and proposals: proven by a game day (make chaos-run), not by this check
- the backup image: published, not deployed to staging
- Slack approval: staging has no Slack app of its own

## Rollback plan

Prod runs `sha-791c44d` today, so that is the version to go back to.

```
gh workflow run rollback.yml --ref main -f tag=sha-791c44d -f reason="<why>"
```

Going back crosses no database migration.

Last measured: about 80 seconds from merging the rollback pull request to every service healthy (staging, 2026-10-09, ADR-0034). Prod's own time has not been measured. Runbook: `docs/runbooks/rollback-prod.md`.
